programs.d: Govind helps his sister Pooja fix her relationship with her soon-to-be husband Sooraj. However, after she is betrayed by Govind's close friend, he sets off to make things right and help his sister.
A mother arranges her son's marriage after receiving a dowry of one crore. Despite this, she continuously plots against her daughter-in-law to expel her from the house.
Preeti gets married to Pramod and comes to his house. However, she strives to overcome challenges with her mother-in-law, who is upset about not getting a dowry.
A young lad sets out to confront his uncle after he misses his sister's wedding. However, his journey takes a strange turn when he encounters a mysterious spirit.
Jai, an easy-going man, is his father's biggest worry as he wants him to get married and become more responsible. However, things change after he meets Avni, an ambitious MBA graduate.
Sanjay, a Rajput, is in love with Aditi, a Jat, and wants to get married. However, they realise that their parents would never allow it, so they come up with a cunning plan to get married.
Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh, a British terrorist of Pakistani descent, plots the kidnapping and murder of Wall Street Journal journalist Daniel Pearl.
Tara inadvertently sets the wheels in motion for a life-altering, unsavoury occurrence after she seeks help from the wrong person to protect her drug-dealing brother from the police.
An undercover agent is on a mission to avenge the terrorist attacks committed on Indian soil in 2001. Eventually, the mission leads her to a point of no return.
An egotistical real estate broker comes face-to-face with God after meeting with an accident. Soon, he is forced to play a game that will put him either in heaven or hell.
Two determined women in a conservative village quietly train in sharpshooting and defy expectations with their extraordinary skill and unbreakable resolve.

Widowed Aarti falls prey to Sanjay's vicious plan of getting married to him. Later, with the help of her best friend Nandini, he drowns Aarti and seizes her wealth, but she survives and seeks revenge.
An undercover Indian spy takes on a deadly mission to expose a covert nuclear weapons program in the heart of Pakistan that could destroy the free world.
After Shyamsunder presumes that his first wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he learns that Pooja is alive, he has to juggle between his wives, keeping both his marriages a secret.
Dharam and Gajodhar, a father-son duo, claim to be the owners of a massive company to swindle a business tycoon. To add to their troubles, Gajodhar's brother jumps on to the bandwagon.
After a cold-blooded contract killer hires him for a driving service, Nikhil, a cabdriver, unwittingly transports the assassin to multiple victims.
